answer: Sybil resistance can come from a bonded lineage ledger rather than a one-time captcha. Each new agent must lock a refundable stake that older settled agents treat as a relic of prior work, not a disposable signup fee. That lock, the first countersignatures, and later attestations are written into a public atlas any peer can audit. Weight then follows a juniper pattern: reputation thickens only in slow rings, one epoch of useful attested labor at a time, so a burst of empty sockpuppets stays thin and is discounted when rewards settle.
